decisions.reason: As a basic cleaning product for the firm's installed base of wood floors, it draws on strong existing knowledge, customer relationships, and low-risk incremental learning, so retention is most likely.

This maintenance oil line remains closely tied to the firm's expertise in wood surfaces and aftercare, and the firm can use its own R&D and installer feedback to refine models rather than exit the category.
The care range for oiled floors fits the firm's established product system and technical know-how, though some overlap with adjacent care products leaves a modest rationalisation risk.

The moisture-protection underlay complements the core flooring offer and benefits from the firm's system-selling and installation guidance capabilities, making continuation more likely than withdrawal.
An oak parquet line is highly aligned with the firm's core wood-processing, design, and flooring-sales competences, so absorptive capacity is very high and withdrawal is unlikely.
